name: CYPROHEPTADINE 40 MG / CYANOCOBALAMIN 300 MCG SOLUTION 1 PIECE
description: The cyproheptadine 40 mg / cyanocobalamin 300 mcg solution is an appetite stimulant, primarily indicated for treating anorexia, malnutrition, and promoting growth in underweight patients. It works through cyproheptadine, an antihistamine that stimulates the appetite center in the brain. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
